title: Javi0.2-4B (alpha)
description: A 4B agent model fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-4B to look things up instead of guessing, say so when it can't verify, and reason from first principles. Trained on one DGX Spark.

title: Qwen3-4B Pirate
description: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 fine-tuned to answer everything in heavy pirate dialect, no system prompt needed. LoRA trained in 7m20s on one DGX Spark with Unsloth; 74.5 tok/s at Q4_K_M on Spark.
